description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP: from a DME image and a drive log with exhaust temperature, the rf_korr table (KF_RF_KORR_DRREL, exhaust-temperature density correction) the drive supports, with the evidence per cell. Experimental in the app; returns values only — the WORKS build of TUNER makes the file and writes it.

bin_path.description: Path to the 64 KB (65,536-byte) MSS54HP calibration partial ("0401 partial BIN") on this machine.

log_path.description: Path to a drive log CSV on this machine: a Testo MSS54 export, or a CSV TUNER exported.

use_sample.description: Use the bundled practice BIN and practice drive instead of files — to show what the tool does before the owner has files.

name: propose_rfkorr
title: rf_korr table from a drive (experimental)
